verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a minutes-long quickstart, a free tier with no credit card, and per-environment enable/disable of flags, including a toggle endpoint. A user reports a working flag in about 15 minutes, and a runtime probe confirmed a flag create-and-evaluate loop with no account or license. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of toggling a flag in a production environment and watching the change propagate; real-time streaming is documented only for JavaScript/React via the proxy.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a feature flag and toggle it live in production within minutes of signing up

citations.quote: Get GrowthBook running in your application in minutes.
Free No credit card required Up to 3 users 1 project Unlimited feature flags
Feature flags can be enabled and disabled on a per-environment basis.
the toggle feature endpoint, which switches a flag on or off in one or more environments

a real flag create-and-evaluate loop with no account or license
